contract.purpose: The Studio app shell, shadcn sidebar-15: the left sidebar holds the N1 navigation (sidebar-07 content) and the right sidebar holds the chat. The header's far-left icon toggles the left sidebar; its far-right icon, after a vertical separator, toggles the chat; both open states persist in cookies. Every other header icon opens one popover from the page manifest (navigator, checks, versions, copy link, request change); Esc and an outside click close it, ?p= keeps it open across reloads, and each is a command menu entry with its shortcut. Below 768px both sidebars are sheets. #studio-main is the page scroller.
